title: Therapeutic alliance across delivery modalities: a systematic narrative review of alliance strength and outcome prediction in face-to-face, online, and blended psychotherapy.
venue: Journal of Zhejiang University. Science. B
quote: The results showed that TA was broadly equivalent across FTF, PO, and BLD formats, although asynchronous PO might show a transient week-2 lag
summary: Revisão sistemática narrativa de 9 estudos (3 ECRs): a aliança foi amplamente equivalente entre presencial, online e misto, com possível atraso na semana 2 no formato assíncrono.
